text:
nora: Quick sync re: Modalytics partner ask — they want a 'reserved partner lane' add-on: guaranteed per-route throughput + revenue share on overage. Need product/finance/eng/legal alignment before we take to BD.

devin: Curious on specifics. Are they asking for a dedicated pool or soft-reserved capacity that spills to hosted?

maria: Modalytics says: dedicated logical lane (not full GPU reservation) guaranteeing 95th pct latency <250ms for partner-tagged routes, with billed overage split 70/30 (Redwood/Modalytics). They want low commit and revenue share to incentivize co-selling.

harpreet: From infra: we can implement soft-reservation by prioritizing scheduling and weights, but true isolation requires dedicated pools. Soft-reserve means potential neighbor impact if spikes are huge.

devin: Product note: add-on should be configurable per-route. Suggest config: ```json
{"partner_lane": {"reserved_qps":2000,"spill_to_hosted":true,"priority":"partner"}}
```

nora: Revenue share mechanics: Modalytics wants us to apply share to billed tokens above reserved baseline. Need clear invoicing and attribution.

financebot: We can support revenue share, but need automated attribution events and monthly reconciliation CSV. Also require a minimum monthly guarantee on Redwood's net for accounting.

legalbot: Modalytics requests indemnity carveouts and a clause preventing the partner lane from being used to reprice baseline commit for other customers. We'll need to limit legal exposure; revenue share increases complexity.

maria: Sales asks: Modalytics will pay a small setup fee + no commit. They want a partner-branded Console tile showing partner performance and earnings.

devin: UI wise, adding a partner tag + earnings export is doable but nontrivial. We can build minimal view (partner summary + CSV export) for v1.

harpreet: Ops concerns: priority scheduling can starve normal traffic during sustained partner spikes. Need deterministic throttles and emergency fallback to degrade partner lane before others. Define triggers in runbook.

nora: Proposed guardrails: 1) max_partner_share_percent_of_pool = 30%, 2) spill triggers CPU>85% or tail>500ms for >3m, 3) emergency throttle will reduce partner lane qps by 50% before throttling others.

financebot: Billing text proposal: "Partner lane reserved baseline billed to partner at agreed list price. Usage above baseline billed at on-demand; Redwood retains 70% of overage revenue. Monthly reconciliation with export provided. Redwood reserves protective throttling under defined triggers."

legalbot: Change "reserves protective throttling" -> "may apply reasonable protective measures as defined in the runbook". Also need to cap liability and clarify revenue reporting cadence.

devin: Implementation sketch (runtime): add `partner_lane` object on route with fields: reserved_qps (int), reserved_tokens_month (int), partner_id (string), share_basis ("overage_tokens"). Emit events: `partner_lane.allocated`, `.spill`, `.payout`.

maria: Modalytics will insist on a dashboard and weekly payout file. Finance: can we do weekly payouts?

financebot: Weekly payouts are operationally heavy. Recommend monthly payout with weekly preview CSV. That balances partner needs and ops cost.

harpreet: Also recommend a soft limit on partner lane setup count per cluster to reduce fragmentation. Maybe enable no more than 5 partner lanes per cluster by default.

nora: Launch criteria: 1) eng spec + runbook w/ triggers, 2) telemetry events and Console MVP, 3) finance reconciliation flow + sample export, 4) legal partner addendum template, 5) pilot one customer.

devin: I'll open ticket and PR template: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-9001

salesbot: INF-9001 created and assigned to devin, harpreet, maria  due 2026-06-01.

maria: Next steps: devin -> spec + telemetry schema by Wed; finance -> reconciliation playbook + payout cadence by Fri; legal -> draft partner addendum by next Tue; harpreet -> capacity guardrails proposal by Thu.

nora: If all green, we'll spin up a 6-week pilot with Modalytics. Thanks.
